Olympiakos Nicosia is a Cypriot football club based in Nicosia and competes in the First Division. The club was founded in 1931, and is a founding member of the Cyprus Football Association. The club colors are black and green. Olympiakos' home ground is the new GSP Stadium, which has a 23,000-seat capacity. The team's main nickname is \"mavroprasini\", and the club's other nickname is Taktakalas, derived from the area of Nicosia where the club hails from.
